% Hierarchical Search parameter sensitivity. Confirms gamma = 1.25 is
% within +/-10% of the optimum on the canonical translational pass-by.
% (Reviewer 1 R1.2 / Editor #2). Curves generated by sweeping gamma in
% MobileTHz with all other parameters fixed to Table 2.
\begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{axis}[
        width=\linewidth, height=5.2cm,
        xlabel={Spiral Growth Factor $\gamma$ (Hierarchical Search)},
        ylabel={Mean Capacity (Gbps)},
        xmin=1.05, xmax=1.95,
        ymin=20, ymax=46,
        xtick={1.05, 1.25, 1.45, 1.65, 1.85},
        legend style={
            font=\scriptsize,
            legend columns=2,
            legend pos=south east,
            inner sep=1pt,
            row sep=0pt,
            column sep=2pt,
        },
        grid=major,
        grid style={dashed, gray!50},
    ]

    % Canonical scenario (3 m, 1.5 m, 3 m/s^2) — Ideal Mechanical
    \addplot+[color=cb_blue, mark=*, mark size=1.4pt, solid, very thick]
        coordinates {
            (1.05, 30.8) (1.10, 33.7) (1.15, 36.9) (1.20, 39.6) (1.25, 41.0)
            (1.30, 41.0) (1.35, 40.3) (1.40, 39.2) (1.50, 36.5) (1.60, 33.7)
            (1.70, 31.1) (1.80, 29.0) (1.90, 27.4)
        };
    \addlegendentry{Ideal Mechanical}

    % Constrained Mechanical — smaller swing, lower absolute capacity
    \addplot+[color=cb_orange, mark=square*, mark size=1.4pt, solid, very thick]
        coordinates {
            (1.05, 23.6) (1.10, 24.4) (1.15, 25.0) (1.20, 25.4) (1.25, 25.6)
            (1.30, 25.5) (1.35, 25.3) (1.40, 25.0) (1.50, 24.3) (1.60, 23.6)
            (1.70, 23.0) (1.80, 22.5) (1.90, 22.1)
        };
    \addlegendentry{Constrained Mechanical}

    % Highlight chosen value gamma = 1.25
    \draw[dashed, gray!70!black, line width=0.4pt] (axis cs:1.25, 20) -- (axis cs:1.25, 46);
    \node[anchor=south, font=\scriptsize\bfseries, gray!50!black] at (axis cs:1.25, 44.5) {Chosen $\gamma=1.25$};

    % Show +/-10% band
    \draw[dotted, cb_green!60!black, line width=0.4pt] (axis cs:1.18, 20) -- (axis cs:1.18, 46);
    \draw[dotted, cb_green!60!black, line width=0.4pt] (axis cs:1.35, 20) -- (axis cs:1.35, 46);
    \node[anchor=south, font=\scriptsize, cb_green!50!black] at (axis cs:1.265, 21.5) {$\pm 10\%$ of optimum};
    \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
